verdict.rationale: Embedding an automation platform white-label for end customers is a fair question for a workflow-orchestration platform, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only self-hosted deployment, Namespace isolation, SDKs and a Temporal Client. These are developer building blocks and adjacent features, not a documented white-label or embeddable customer-facing offering.

support.subject: As a developer, I can embed the automation platform white-label inside my own product for my customers
